lines.text: The man brought Ezekiel into the outer sanctuary and measured it as forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.
The man measured the room beside the inner sanctuary and called it the Most Holy Place.
Carved cherubim alternated with olive trees, and each cherub had a man's face and a young lion's face.
The priests who approach the LORD eat the most holy offerings and leave their ministering garments behind.
The man measured all four sides of the area, and each side was a hundred cubits long.
